proposals.before: Following the model of the 《Five Dynasties Administrative Geography Study》, this 《Study of New Moons》 records Khitan prefectures and garrisons.
proposals.after: Following the model of how the 《Five Dynasties Administrative Geography Study》 recorded Khitan prefectures and garrisons, the 《Study of New Moons》 was composed.
proposals.reason: Chinese 用…例，作《朔考》 means the New Moons study was composed on the model of that geography work's comparative format; the idiomatic wrongly makes the New Moons study itself the record of Khitan prefectures.

proposals.before: Astronomical changes across the six directions' surface could be looked up at—such was the jade sight-rule of Yu's era.
proposals.after: Astronomical changes across the six directions' surface could be looked up at—such was the jade sight-rule of Youyu's era.
proposals.reason: 有虞 is the dynastic designation of Shun (Youyu), not Yu (禹); the idiomatic correctly has Shun.

decisions.reason: Chinese 用《五代職方考》誌契丹州軍例，作《朔考》 makes 《朔考》 the work composed (作) on the model of how the geography treatise recorded Khitan prefectures and armies; the idiomatic wrongly treats 《朔考》 itself as that record of prefectures.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 用《五代職方考》誌契丹州軍例，作《朔考》。

decisions.reason: 有虞 names Shun's Youyu designation, parallel to 陶唐 for Yao in the prior sentence; rendering it as Yu (禹) confuses a different legendary ruler, while Youyu matches the Chinese and the idiomatic's Shun.
